chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Abbas ibn 'Amir, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He (peace be upon him) said: "Breastfeeding after the two years, before weaning, causes prohibition (of marriage)."

This is a singular report (khabar shadh) that does not contradict the reports we have previously presented due to their abundance, and it is permissible that it was derived from taqiyya (dissimulation) because it is the opinion of some of the Sunnis. As for what he narrated:
ai.seo_question: Does breastfeeding after two years establish mahram relationship in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi identifies this report from Abu Abdillah (al-Sadiq) as a singular (shadh) narration, noting that the established consensus holds that breastfeeding after two years does not establish prohibition. He suggests the Imam may have reported it as valid due to taqiyya, aligning with the Hanafi view that nursing at any age creates kinship, or simply to avoid conflict with the general public.
